changedFields.before: Ein Größenmarker begründet eine ungefähre Fragmentlänge. Gleiche Wanderung beweist unter diesen Bedingungen vergleichbare Länge, nicht gleiche Basensequenz, Identität eines Menschen oder Erkrankung.

independentChecks: Negative DNA toward positive electrode; short linear fragments farther under comparable conditions.
Marker/unknown 28 and 44 mm correctly assign about 1000 and 500 bp.
Second marker 30 mm correctly assigns about 600 bp to both supplied PCR products; restriction bands 16 and 30 mm give about 1200 and 600 bp.
Changed lane relationship and inferential claim distinguish the second case from a mere numeric substitution.
Band coincidence supports approximate length; it does not identify sequence, a person, or disease.
Supplied PCR/restriction labels do not require learners to perform or explain PCR/restriction.
At least two independent demonstrations plus fresh transfer required; no exact marker-number recall demanded.
No active record, human authority or mastery state was written.
